title: Coating lasted 1-1/2 years on the pot's top edge - wearing off where the lid contacts the pot
text: Coating lasted 1-1/2 years on the pot's top edge - wearing off where the lid contacts the pot. The "ceramic" coating is wearing off in tiny chips at the top of the pot where the glass lid with metal rim sits on the pot.  The tiny chips are likely going into the food I'm cooking.  Since the pot itself is metal, it would have been easy to design it so the metal lid only contacted metal at the top of the pot, but that's not how it was made.  I only use this pot once a week, so after 75 uses it is ready to be given to a thrift store.  We have a stainless steel cookware set that was used by my parents and now us for 70 years and thousands of uses with no issues!

features: GreenPan’s Thermolon healthy ceramic nonstick coating is free of PFAS, PFOA, lead, and cadmium, so it will never release toxic fumes, even if it’s accidentally overheated
Tough, diamond-reinforced nonstick coating is incredibly durable
Heavy-gauge construction provides excellent heat conduction
description: Add a touch of color to your kitchen with the vibrant style of the GreenPan Rio collection. This versatile 1QT saucepan is perfect for sides and is designed to make your meals better. How? This pan features our Thermolon healthy ceramic nonstick coating—an easy release and wipe clean coating that’s free of PFAS, PFOA, lead, and cadmium for worry-free cooking. Unlike many other nonstick coatings, it will never release toxic fumes, even if it’s overheated. This durable coating is reinforced with diamonds to provide peak nonstick performance longer. The pan’s heavy-duty construction gives you even heat distribution while the stay-cool Bakelite handle give you a comfortable grip and total control. A durable glass lid gives you an easy view of your meal in progress without sacrificing heat. Dishwasher safe. The pan and lid are oven safe to 350°F..
